data.one_liner: Widgets providing pull-down refresh capability with Material and Cupertino styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of widgets that enable pull-down refreshing in Flutter applications. It supports Material, Cupertino, and adaptive platform styles, as well as builder methods for list views.
use_when: You need pull-to-refresh functionality supporting multiple design systems.
You want a platform-adaptive refresh indicator.
avoid_when: You are already using standard platform refresh widgets like RefreshIndicator and don't need extra stream control.
strengths: Fully written in Flutter and works on all platforms
Supports Material, Cupertino, and adaptive styles
Fully covered by tests and documented
weaknesses: Requires manual state management via streams to hide the refresh indicator
